game_20260226_003306_g4:14.description: Playing Boseiju, Who Endures as a land wastes its powerful Channel ability (destroy artifact/enchantment/nonbasic land). Eldrazi Temple would have been better since it also enables casting Glaring Fleshraker this turn ({C}{C} from Ugin's Labyrinth + {C} from Eldrazi Temple = {2}{C}) while providing superior mana for future Eldrazi spells like Kozilek's Command, and preserving Boseiju as removal.

game_20260226_003306_g4:6.description: Chose Walking Ballista over Eldrazi Temple from Devourer of Destiny's look-at-4 ability. A second Eldrazi Temple would provide significant mana acceleration for the Eldrazi-heavy hand (Glaring Fleshraker, Kozilek's Command, Devourer of Destiny), enabling faster deployment of key threats. The player already has 4 lands in hand, so the extra Temple's CC for Eldrazi spells is more valuable than Walking Ballista as a mana sink.

game_20260226_003306_g4:22.description: Fetched Blood Crypt instead of a basic Mountain. They already have a Blood Crypt for black mana, and their hand (Burning Inquiry R, Orcish Bowmasters 1B, Mountain) means a basic Mountain covers all their mana needs. Fetching Blood Crypt costs an extra 2 life to enter untapped (or enters tapped, wasting tempo) for no benefit.

game_20260219_091818_g8:46.description: Passing with the option to discard a redundant land to Psychic Frog for a permanent +1/+1 counter. With 4 lands in hand (Bloodstained Mire, Island, Watery Grave, Watery Grave) and only needing a few more land drops, discarding an excess land now grows the Frog for next turn's attack at minimal cost. It also builds graveyard resources for Frog's flying ability.

game_20260217_223017_g8:11.description: At 2 life against an opponent at 16 with threatening creatures, choosing Oblivious Bookworm over Deep-Cavern Bat for the Superior Spider-Man copy is a significant error. Deep-Cavern Bat would give a 4/4 with flying and lifelink — the lifelink is critical for survival at 2 life, the flying helps block Enduring Curiosity or attack over ground creatures, and the ETB lets you see and exile a card from the opponent's 7-card hand. Oblivious Bookworm's card draw with mandatory discard is far less impactful when you're about to die.

game_20260219_091818_g8:67.description: Passed priority in precombat main without pumping Psychic Frog before combat. The opponent has Fallaji Archaeologist 0/3 which can block the 1/2 Frog on the ground, preventing combat damage and the card draw trigger. Kimi25 has 4 cards in graveyard and could exile 3 to give Frog flying, and discard Street Wraith to make it a 2/3 flyer that gets through for damage and draws a card.

game_20260217_223017_g8:7.description: Copying Wistfulness with Superior Spider-Man creates a vanilla 4/4 since neither {G}{G} nor {U}{U} was spent to cast Superior Spider-Man. Copying Oblivious Bookworm would create a 4/4 with repeatable card filtering (draw then discard) each end step, which is significantly more valuable especially with only 2 cards in hand and needing to find more threats/answers.

game_20260217_223017_g8:24.description: Attempted to cast Shoot the Sheriff but couldn't complete the mana payment, resulting in a rolled-back action. Floodpits Drowner was available at {1}{U} which could flash in, tap Superior Spider-Man (4/4), and prevent 4 combat damage while adding a body for a potential lethal counterattack next turn against the opponent at 2 life.

game_20260217_223017_g8:3.description: Cast Enduring Curiosity using all 4 mana, leaving no interaction for opponent's Oblivious Bookworm end step trigger. Bookworm will draw opponent a card (and likely keep it since they played a land this turn... no, face-down requirement). Kimi had Shoot the Sheriff to cleanly kill Bookworm or Tishana's Tidebinder to counter the trigger and permanently strip its abilities.

game_20260226_003306_g4:3.description: Bottomed Hollow One instead of a redundant third land. With Burning Inquiry in hand, Hollow One becomes free (3 discards = 6 mana reduction). The T1 line of Mountain → Marauding Mako → Burning Inquiry → free Hollow One is an explosive start that creates a 4/4 and a Mako with +3/+3 counters (from 3 random discards). Even with random discard risk, keeping Hollow One has very high expected value.

game_20260226_003306_g4:9.description: Playing Blood Crypt as the first land when they have Bloodstained Mire and Mountain available. With zero lands on board, paying 2 life for an untapped Blood Crypt provides marginal benefit since they can't cast Orcish Bowmasters with just one land anyway. A Bloodstained Mire would provide more flexibility (crack at instant speed, deck thinning, fetch the right land when needed), or Mountain would provide R mana for free (enabling Marauding Mako without life cost).
